meta.title: CRM Workspace Hub (dsh-crm-workspace)
meta.description: A dynamic scenario container for enterprise CRM work: administrators define scenario cards (title, description, icon, category, slash command, pinnedSkills, default object/action/form entry, welcome message); clicking a card activates its pinnedSkills stack in order and injects the scenario context into the current session, so the model never has to blindly route across a global skill catalogue.
